{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm: only two channels exist
assert len(df['channel'].unique()) == 2, 'Expected exactly two channels, found more or less'

# Check for sentinel values in revenue
print("Checking for sentinel revenue values (999999.99):")
print(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Check for missing age sentinel
print("\nChecking for customer_age = -1:")
print(df[df['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_age'].count())"}
